Outlier robustness of the associations between CP and adult cognition in preterm-born adults (BLS cohort; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 5). The cognition GLMs (outcome \~ CP + age at scan + sex) are re-run after excluding outlier CP observations (IQR criterion, per ROI).

- Input: `checkpoints/eda_checkpoint.rds` and `checkpoints/glm_checkpoint.rds` (from `eda.qmd` and `GLM_analyses_essential.qmd`)
- Output: `outputs/tables/Revision_cognition_outliers-excluded_<date>.csv` (results/cognition_GLM_BLS_outliers_excluded.csv)

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Load checkpoints

```{r}
eda <- readRDS(here::here("checkpoints", "eda_checkpoint.rds"))
glm <- readRDS(here::here("checkpoints", "glm_checkpoint.rds"))

list2env(eda, envir = .GlobalEnv)
list2env(glm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
rm(eda, glm)
```

# Run analysis

### 1 GLM helper function

```{r}
run_outcome_vs_each_cp <- function(outcome, family, data = dat_PT_cog){
  map_dfr(cp_vars, function(cp_col){
    fml <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(cp_col, covars), collapse = " + ")))
    df  <- data[, all.vars(fml)] %>% na.omit()
    if (nrow(df) < 10) return(NULL)
    fit <- lm(fml, data = df); td <- tidy(fit); gl <- glance(fit)
    row <- td %>% filter(term == cp_col); if (!nrow(row)) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      family = family, outcome = outcome, dv_label = outcome,
      predictor = cp_col, estimate = row$estimate, std.error = row$std.error,
      ci_lo = estimate - 1.96 * std.error, ci_hi = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      t_value = row$statistic, p.value = row$p.value,
      r.squared = gl$r.squared, adj.r.squared = gl$adj.r.squared, n = nrow(df)
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome)) %>%
  group_by(outcome) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_fdr_within_outcome = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup()
}
```

### 2 Build datasets

```{r}
stopifnot(exists("final_dat_CP_excl"))   # created in eda.qmd

dat_PT_excl <- final_dat_CP_excl %>% filter(group == "PT")

dat_PT_cog_excl <- dat_PT_excl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(cp_vars, cog_all)), ~ {
      if (is.factor(.)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))) else as.numeric(.)
    }),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cp_vars), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))) #z-scoring cp vars
  )
```

### 3 Re-run cognition GLM with outliers excluded

```{r}
# run GLM for each cognitive outcome against each CP ROI
res_single_excl <- bind_rows(
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("wie_gesiq",      "FSIQ", data = dat_PT_cog_excl),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_alerting",   "ANT",  data = dat_PT_cog_excl),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_orienting",  "ANT",  data = dat_PT_cog_excl),
  run_outcome_vs_each_cp("ant_congruency", "ANT",  data = dat_PT_cog_excl)
) %>% arrange(outcome, p_adj_fdr_within_outcome, p.value)

# save output:
write_csv2(res_single_excl, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_cognition_outliers-excluded_", format(Sys.Date()), ".csv")))
```
